bias.en: Downtrend · bounced off $141, back at $149 resistance
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 自 $141 反弹，回到 $149 阻力

read.en: Marvell rose 2.3% on Nov 17 to $148.74, recovering from an intraday low of $140.90 to a $150.94 high. It is below the 10-day ($152.8, falling), 5-day ($156.8), 200-day ($187.7), 30-day ($209.1) and 100-day ($223.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 29 ($168.08), and RSI is 34.2.
read.zh: Marvell 11月17日上涨 2.3%，收于 $148.74，盘中自低点 $140.90 回升至高点 $150.94。股价位于 10 日（$152.8，下行）、5 日（$156.8）、200 日（$187.7）、30 日（$209.1）和 100 日均线（$223.0）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月29日起看空（$168.08），RSI 为 34.2。

read.en: The $140.90 low held the Nov 6 close ($141.20) and the stock closed back inside the $146.9–149.2 band. Resistance is $149.2–150.9 (Nov 13 low, Nov 16–17 highs), then $152.8–154.6 (10-day, Nov 9–10 closes) and $156.8–159.8 (5-day, Nov 4 close). Support is $144–145.4 (Nov 16 low and close), then $140.9–141.2 and $135.3 (Nov 6 low). A close above $150.9 would target $153–155; below $140.9, $135.3.

r.en: Nov 16 high $149.16; Nov 13 low $149.17; Nov 17 high $150.94
